itemized_evaluation.justification: Explicit conflict of interest and funding disclosures are present in the 'Competing interests' and 'Funding' sections: 'D.S. is the founder and a beneficiary of FreshCredit Inc... The theoretical results and the patented methods overlap in composition; the author discloses this overlap explicitly.' and 'Funding: None received; independent research.'

The paper is a self-deposited preprint on OSF / Zenodo / GitHub without documented peer-review credentials from a reputable journal or institutional review board ('companion preprints deposited at OSF'; 'Accession: https://github.com/devonshigaki/trust-stack-research-collection/releases/tag/v4.3').

Prior works and literature are represented with extreme accuracy, including explicit caveats and limitations of cited works: 'Section 1.2a Prior art: what is not new about the trust vector... The update rule itself is not new — and it is not ours.' and 'Kettlewell & Tymula’s own attenuation alternative is carried with the estimate: measurement error could explain much of the stated/behavioral gap...' (§4.1).

Establishes a fully reproducible protocol with open code, seeds, and formal verification: 'All simulation code, seeds, formal SMT proofs, high-resolution figures, and pre-registration documents are permanently deposited and publicly accessible in the open research archive... with cryptographic SHA-256 manifest verification... Every mathematical invariant and empirical claim is verified via an automated 26-task continuous integration test harness' (Data availability; §2.3b; §3.6).

Sampling and initialization in simulation batteries are explicitly randomized, unbiased, and controlled for measurement bias: '200 random initial conditions on \Delta^4' (§3.6 Sim G1), 'Sixty uniform-random initial conditions on \Delta^4' (§3.6 Sim G6), and explicit controls for phase-map measurement bias in §3.4 ('Phase-map choice: stereographic, not arctan...').

Sample sizes in simulations are explicitly justified via finite-size scaling and autocorrelation time requirements: 'Finite-size scaling (N = 500/2000/5000) confirms the R = 0.7 crossing is a property of the order-parameter curve, not a finite-N artifact' (§3.6 Sim G1b); '64 chains \times 10^5 - 3\cdot 10^5 steps, \geq 30 autocorrelation times per run' (§3.3 Sim G9); and power analyses are registered for the empirical program (§6).

Proper controls are used throughout the numerical experiments, and the impossibility of zero-salience blinding/observation in human trust measurement is explicitly justified and modeled mathematically: 'The honesty condition: \psi = 0 is not achievable by any architecture, including ours... residual-salience controls are included in the design' (§3.3, §6 H4) and 'Phase-map control battery (200 seeds, K = 0, N = 500...)' (§3.4).

Appropriate statistical tests matching data types (e.g., Mann-Whitney U, permutation tests, Shapiro-Wilk, Spearman rho) are applied alongside explicit effect sizes (Hedges' g, BCa bootstrap CIs, SESOI): 'Mann–Whitney U = 1600/1600, p = 7.2 \times 10^{-15}; 10,000-replicate label-swap permutation p = 1 \times 10^{-4}... Hedges g = 7.4 [6.2, 8.6] on log-centroids... both groups Gaussian-plausible by Shapiro–Wilk at n = 40' (§3.6 Sim G6 M2) and 'pre-registered smallest effect size of interest (SESOI)' (§6 H2).

Randomization methods, seeds, and parameter allocations across simulation conditions and user cohorts are fully detailed: 'seed 20260908; 60 uniform-random initial conditions on \Delta^4' (§3.6), 'N = 300 users with cadence, sign mixture, tails, and the deliberately misspecified Gaussian fit matched to the prior battery... seed 42' (§6 SIM-R1).

Standard deviations, confidence intervals, percentiles, and exact p-values are rigorously reported throughout: e.g., '0.635 \pm 0.014 over 200 seeds' (§3.4), 'dispersion ratio 0.053, BCa bootstrap 95% CI [0.0475, 0.0594]' (§3.6), 'Mann–Whitney U = 1600/1600, p = 7.2 \times 10^{-15}' (§3.6), 'mean 0.117, p95 0.255, max 0.556' (§6).

Raw numbers, baselines, and absolute metrics are consistently provided alongside relative ratios and percentages: 'with 65 of 300 users (21.7%) outside the corridor' (§6 SIM-R1), 'mean Hellinger-chord distance to T^* falls from 0.295 to 0.016 (dispersion ratio 0.053)' (§3.6 Sim G6 M1), and 'mean pairwise Fisher–Rao distance ranges 0.118–0.217 across the grid — a 1.83\times spread around the baseline 0.166' (§3.1).

Failed operationalizations, failed criteria, and registration gaps are transparently logged and accounted for: 'The four failed operationalizations preceding this result... are preserved in §S' (§3.6 M2), 'Verdicts per frozen criteria: C1–C4, C6 PASS; C5 FAIL; compound FAIL' (§4.6 Sim G22), and 'Registration gap, stated plainly: the pre-registered \hat{a}_i values are printed nowhere in the stack...' (§3.1).

The paper explicitly guards against swapping true constructs for convenient proxies: 'The survey instrument is a measurement landmine, and GTT marks it... GTT therefore treats GSS-style survey trust as, at best, a noisy proxy... never from the survey item' (§1.2b), and explicitly separates latent state S from observable proxy readout H_t in §6 ('Here H_t denotes the observable stabilization readout... distinct from the latent state').

Statistical findings, simulation checks, and stylized facts are strictly distinguished from real-world or clinical/practical significance: 'The magnitudes disagree by roughly 2.5 orders (1.9 vs 575.4); the check establishes only sign-level concordance... No distributional equality, calibration, or "anchoring" between model and data is claimed' (§3.6 M3), and 'corroboration inside it is weak evidence' (§6 H2).

Correlation is never presented as causation, and confounding variables/observer effects are explicitly addressed: 'a cross-country regression in which causality may run from institutions to both trust and growth, and the instruments are weak; we cite the association, not the causation' (§4.4), 'we note these are associational estimates... not as links in a causal chain' (§4.4), and the open '\lambda \cdot r_t product confound' is explicitly detailed in §6.

Figures and visual representations are described with explicit baselines, theoretical overlays, finite-size floors, and error bands: e.g., 'with the R = 0.7 target, the 1/\sqrt{N} floor, and the K = 4.5 operating point marked' (Figure SR2), 'Shaded ribbons: 95% bootstrap CIs (10,000 draws)' (Figure SR6), and 'Zero-coupling coherence: the half-circle map reports R = 0.636 \pm 0.014 (artifact); the stereographic map restores the finite-size floor at 0.041 \pm 0.022' (Figure S1).

Hypotheses and simulation criteria are pre-registered before data collection/runs, and post-hoc parameter adjustment is explicitly forbidden: 'All precision/prior parameters are fixed a priori (or fit on a training partition); post-hoc adjustment of precisions after a failed prediction is forbidden by protocol (§4.3)' (§6), and 'criteria specified in code before the reported runs' (§3.6).

Simulation horizons are explicitly designed to be long enough (10^5 to 3*10^5 steps, >= 30 autocorrelation times) to detect long-term pathologies, unbounded drift, and recovery times: 'Sim G7 (long-horizon simulation, 10^5 events...): (i) under a stationary honest stream with small positive drift, S grows without bound (S = 249 after 10^5 events)... (ii) a betrayal shock leaves a permanent displacement...' (§3.2, §3.6).

Extrapolation limits, saturation bounds, and domain boundaries are explicitly enforced: 'Saturation caveat. Under the physics-layer preset S is an unbounded integrator, so the default index \iota = \tanh(S/s_d) saturates at \pm 1... the index’s useful dynamic range is |S| \lesssim 2 s_d' (§2.3), and 'Scope limits and negative domain. (i) Incommensurable domains... (ii) Self-trust... (iv) Equilibrium-tool limits' (§7).

Mathematical boundaries (e.g., probability simplex invariance, positivity, bounded distortion, elimination of metric singularities at boundaries) are formally proved in Lean 4 and Z3 SMT, and non-classical/quantum claims in macroscopic biology/institutions are explicitly disclaimed: 'The Lean kernel has therefore checked each printed claim above end-to-end: tiltP_pos and tiltP_sum...' (§2.3b), 'Elimination of Boundary Singularity (Theorem FR-1)' (§3.1), and 'explicitly disclaims microscopic non-classical phenomena in macroscopic human cognition or social institutions' (§1.2, §3.5).
